narrative.headline: The Avalanche led the league last spring
narrative.blurb: 2026–27 opens Tue, Sep 29 · 5:00 PM. The board below is the 2025–26 finish. The Avalanche are No. 1 at 55-16-11 with 121 points. The East's last playoff spot was the Senators on 99 points. The West's was the Kings on 90 points.
